Scientific software provides a way to put mathematical ideas to work and make
them available to other researchers, instructors, and practitioners.

## QMCPy

[QMCPy](https://qmcpy.org/) is a Python framework for quasi-Monte Carlo sampling
and integration. Its components support sampling schemes, measure transforms,
integrands, and stopping criteria.

[Documentation](https://qmcsoftware.github.io/QMCSoftware/)
· [Source repository](https://github.com/QMCSoftware/QMCSoftware)
· [QMCSoftware community](https://qmcsoftware.org/)

## GAIL

The [Guaranteed Automatic Integration Library](https://gailgithub.github.io/GAIL_Dev/)
provides MATLAB algorithms for numerical integration with guarantees under
their stated assumptions.

[Source repository](https://github.com/GailGithub/GAIL_Dev)

## Hickernell<wbr>AcademicLib

[HickernellAcademicLib](https://github.com/fjhickernell/HickernellAcademicLib)
holds reusable teaching and presentation resources: Quarto styling, components,
notebook helpers, and shared academic content.

[Library website](https://fjhickernell.github.io/HickernellAcademicLib/)
· [Consumer adoption guide](https://github.com/fjhickernell/HickernellAcademicLib/blob/main/docs/consumer-adoption.md)
